measurement.statistic: Arithmetic mean of each engine's two or four per-run sample medians, in nanoseconds; run selection is declared by each cohort.
measurement.scope: Top-level date and measurement settings are the September 13 historical defaults; per-cohort measurement fields override them for September 20 and 27 results. Refreshed rows use matched engines from one source build; historical rows retain their source-comparison cohorts. This is not a full-suite run at the latest revision.
measurement.uncertainty: Each run retains its own Criterion 95% median interval. No pooled confidence interval or aggregate speedup across rows is claimed; within-role drift is retained, separately for each block in balanced cohorts.

measurement.statistic: Arithmetic mean of all four per-engine run medians, in nanoseconds.
measurement.uncertainty: Four original Criterion median intervals per engine; no pooled interval. Range and drift flags above 5 percent are descriptive and never exclude a run.
